name: Layered Polygonal Area Lights
definition: A real-time rendering technique for participating media indirectly visible over reflective surfaces, representing an inhomogeneous volume using multiple layers of area lights to evaluate light contribution from a volume slice between two adjacent layers using an analytic form.
summary: Layered Polygonal Area Lights is a real-time technique that computes indirect illumination in participating media by decomposing volumes into parallel planar slices treated as virtual area lights.
